_about: The contract for GET /api/taxa/{name}/best-map (one taxon) and GET /api/maps/best (every taxon with a map to show). Real answers have exactly these keys, with these types; values here are examples. tests/testthat/test-bestmap.R checks the API against this file. Every answer is 200: a taxon with nothing to show says why in reason.

choice.why: Two or more of its maps beat clustered collecting, so this is their combined map.
choice.label: All passing models together

legend.hatch: No data like it: conditions unlike any surveyed site

combined.caption: Suitable habitat for Laccaria laccata, ranked within its own range. Suitable habitat, not a sighting; not for foraging.
